title: The best!
body:
I really love this app and I still don’t understand why it’s free! 
It’s too good to be free.
So I saw someone’s review on this app saying the app doesn’t have notifications that he even forgot he had the app, but honestly you don’t need notifications in this app to quit whatever addiction you want to quit.
If you ever forget you have this app and you were trying to quit something then trust me what you was trying to quit was never important for you.
Because someone like me trying to quit toxicity, I remember this app always because of how important it is to me for me to quit.
The reasons I love this app:
1)The design is so beautiful and the colours are gorgeous.🥺
2)The app lets you quit over 5 addiction at a time with different counters, and I’ve tried a lot of apps either it’s paid to use or to add over 2 addictions you must pay, but this is free!
3)The app got locker you can lock with your faceid! Something which is also paid in other apps I’ve tried.
I so much love this beautiful app, thanks a lot creator!
You deserve every good things.🥰
